correctness.rationale: The thirty-face presentation reconstructs a closed nonorientable surface with face vector \( (10,45,30) \). Mod-two facial relations have rank \(29\) in the \(36\)-dimensional graph-cycle space, so \(H_1\) has dimension \(7\). All \(90\) nonfacial triangles are exhaustively reduced and all are nonzero; their exact class multiplicities are \(1^{10},2^{25},5^{6}\). All vertex permutations are exhaustively tested, giving the full order-sixty automorphism group, and the induced action verifies the four carrier/class orbit fibers.

value.rationale: A ten-vertex neighborly genus-seven surface is maximally dense at the one-skeleton level, making the first possible simple-cycle layer especially natural. The theorem completely resolves that layer and shows a nontrivial collapse from ninety geometric carriers to forty-one homology classes, with four symmetry orbits and nonuniform fibers. This structure is not encoded by the Betti number, neighborliness, or the abstract \(A_5\) symmetry alone.
